climate: A dry climate, though much of its little rain falls while the vines grow. Water is scarce.

blurb.text: A wine area that is both an IG and a DOC in Mendoza. Malbec leads plantings at 18%, followed by Bonarda (13%) and Cabernet Sauvignon (9%).
